title: AI and Emerging Technologies in Psychology
summary: AI and emerging technologies: human-AI interaction, digital mental health, ethics, algorithmic bias, and research applications in psychology.
objectives: Explain human-AI interaction and digital mental health.
Discuss AI ethics and algorithmic bias.
revision: AI and emerging technologies: human-AI interaction, digital mental health, ethics, algorithmic bias, research applications. Editorial enrichment — not covered in source PDFs.
traps: AI in psychology = AI supporting psychological practice.
Human-AI interaction: people interacting with AI systems.
AI ethics: responsible development and use.

notes.t: The application of artificial intelligence and digital technologies to psychological assessment, intervention, and research.

i: Human-AI interaction: people interacting with AI systems
AI therapy chatbots: conversational agents for mental health support
Digital phenotyping: using digital data to assess mental states
AI ethics: responsible AI development and use
Algorithmic bias: unfair or discriminatory AI outcomes
Privacy: protecting user data in digital mental health

notes.t: AI should serve as a tool to support, not replace, psychological expertise. Human oversight remains essential.
UGC NET may ask about AI applications and ethics in psychology.
